name: City Journey 02 · Frozen Blocks

signs.text: FROZEN DISTRICT: Ice carries your momentum. Shift / Brake stops you. Cross east, then weave north around the open water.
NORTH ON ICE: Turn west after the first water barrier. Tan islands have dry footing and skateboarders.
WEST GAP: Brake before the water, then go north. Watch roaming roaches and the paired skaters.
FINAL GAP: Turn north around the east end of the water. Skate Escape follows this district.

description: A frozen district with open ice, alternating water barriers, dry skateboard islands, roaches and three skating duets. Brake before the edges.
